candidates.description: This vector is related to conditional, temporal, and interrogative conjunctions and correlative adverbs.
These tokens represent common Hindi dependent vowel sign and consonant suffixes used in verb conjugation and inflection.
This vector activates strongly on characters, vowel signs, and fragments from Indic scripts like Hindi.
This vector represents characters from the Devanagari script used in languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector activates for common sub-word units and consonant-vowel conjuncts in the Hindi Devanagari script.
This vector activates for common Hindi verb stems and suffix morphemes.
These tokens represent Hindi vowel matras combined with punctuation marks.
These tokens represent common Hindi verb suffixes, inflectional endings, and root morphemes.
This vector represents Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and common pronominal or locative forms.
This vector represents Hindi characters, sub-word tokens, and numerals commonly used in Devanagari script text processing.
